assessment: This work will be of interest to neuroscientists who want to understand how visual systems are tuned to and encode natural scenes. It reports that rats share phenomenology with humans in sensitivity to spatial correlations in scenes. This shows that an earlier paper's hypothesis about efficient coding may be more broadly applicable. This work also opens up the possibility of studying this kind of visual tuning in an animal where invasive techniques can be used to study this neural origins of this sensitivity and its development.
